title: Alden
summary: Born Sadim, soldier #82 falling to #39 — the eighteen-year-old orphan of Tullanon whose honest journal narrates the Hundred-Eleven, and who cannot leave the company he joined for food.

title: Elric
summary: The Centurion, #1 of the Hundred-Eleven — ancient, cold, and from a wild land across the Eastern Sea; loyal to the contract rather than to people, he has outlived more companies than any soldier should, by a means the drafts do not explain.

title: The Grimoire
summary: The parasitic, human-skin-bound book that binds a mercenary company body and soul, grants its powers, and compels the killing that feeds it — holding thousands of names though the company is only ever 111 strong.

title: The Hundred-Eleven Roster and the Mystery of #45
summary: One of the multiverse's two confirmed cross-universe anchors — the roster of the Hundred-Eleven carries a soldier named Blaze at #45, sharing a name with the protagonist-lineage of an entire other world. What is confirmed is the link; what stays open is how.

title: Universe: The Hundred-Eleven
summary: A grim journal-narrated mercenary saga set in the fractured vassal kingdom of Veleh, where a company of exactly 111 soldiers is bound body and soul to a parasitic human-skin grimoire.

title: The Blaze Tempering
summary: The secret body-cultivation road of Blaze — forty layers that do not store qi but consume it, igniting it to burn impurities out as slag and doubling raw power with each layer, while leaving its bearer invisible to every standard test.

title: Rin
summary: A red-haired slum orphan of Scarlet City, born meridian-defective and for that reason the perfect vessel for the Blaze Tempering — unaware that a Primordial God has chosen his trajectory.

title: Skolar
summary: The con artist who climbed all nine realms to become a Primordial God — the single soul the wiki can follow from the bottom of the ladder to the empty place above the Loom.

title: Universe: Blaze
summary: A small grey cultivation world at the dim edge of the Loom — and the vantage from which the Loom of Heavens is first seen.

title: Whiteflame
summary: A hunted body-cultivation master who, dying, scattered his soul into a hundred blood-drops across the Loom; one drop seeded Rin's road, and his surviving wisp taught the first layers of the Blaze Tempering — leaving a debt of revenge as the price of the inheritance.

title: The Judges of Reincarnation
summary: The celestial bureaucracy that weighs dead souls and reseeds them into new lives — the court that sealed the Charlatan twice and failed to erase his memory, and thereby set the lowest rung of the Spine in motion.

title: Universe: The Charlatan
summary: A xianxia world of sects, noble families, and a celestial bureaucracy of reincarnation — and the mortal origin of the Primordial God Skolar.

title: The Five Doors
summary: The five local mechanisms by which a soul moves between stitches of the Loom — ascension, void-resurrection, divine summoning, judged reincarnation, and engineered gates — which are five names for one act.

title: The Lid Above Every Sky
summary: The political truth of the Loom — that a lower world's sky is not open but a seal placed from above, beneath which the world is farmed and kept ignorant.

title: The Loom of Heavens
summary: The tapestry of worlds in the empty between-place, on which every universe hangs as a single stitch of cold fire.

title: The Nine Realms
summary: The nine-realm ladder of cultivation — the known ascent from a mortal's first breath of qi to the severed godhood of a Primordial God.

title: The Scattered Master
summary: A recurring pattern across the weave — a dying high-realm being seeds a lower stitch with a fragment of itself, whether as blood-drops, soul-ash in a relic, or blood soaked into a sapling. A living mystery the wiki tracks, never a confirmed crossing.

title: The Ten Primordial Daos
summary: The ten fundamental laws from which every lesser Dao descends — two polarities, four Daos of Order, four of Chaos — and the fusion of all ten that makes a Primordial God.

title: Threads of Space vs. Karma Threads
summary: The two kinds of thread that bind the Loom — the great roads between worlds, and the finer private web between souls.

title: Universe: Champion of the Light
summary: A medieval kingdom under invasion where a goddess called the Light summons champions from other worlds to hold the line — and, when they fall, summons them again with their memories wiped, turning heroism into a loop.

title: Virah
summary: The summoned champion of the Light, also called Roger — monstrously strong, regenerative, and stripped of memory by design; a hero who dies to close a rift and is summoned again, emptied, to fight the same war a second time.

title: Ghor
summary: Born a Neanderthal around 45,000 BC, dead at fourteen and bound to a void entity ever since — the immortal wanderer of the Engine, who has gone by Adam more than any other of his hundred names.

title: Universe: The Engine
summary: An immortal-wanderer science-fantasy spanning a hundred thousand years and fifty galaxies, in which a man dies and is reseeded life after life across worlds by the void entity bound to him.

title: Vael
summary: The Spectral Void Entity bound to Ghor since his first death — the unseen source of all his powers, never shown directly, and by her own hint not the only one of her kind.

title: The Hollow Lantern
summary: A relic holding the soul-ash of a dead immortal, which lets its bearer name the flaw in any technique and drink fragments of a vanished life — power whose price is measured in the years of the bearer's own soul.

title: Lu Chen
summary: A village boy branded a "dead root" who is in truth the sealed heir of the erased Lu Clan, and the bearer of the Hollow Lantern — the relic that lets him name any technique's flaw at the cost of ageing his own soul.

title: Universe: The Nine Vaults Continent
summary: A single landmass whose people do not know a larger sky hangs above them — the clearest in-world statement of the Loom's cruelest law, that a sky can be a lid and the world beneath it farmed.

title: Evergreen
summary: A sapling that woke to sentience on the blood of a dying cultivator and climbed the ladder to Monarch — a slow, patient, morally hardening intelligence a thousand kilometres tall, feeding on a planet's magma.

title: Universe: Sky Pillar
summary: A xianxia told from a non-human point of view — the rise of a sentient cultivator tree from a woken sapling to a world-shaking Monarch a thousand kilometres tall.
